page_title: UDI 0-0 ATA | Udinese v Atalanta 11/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Maurizio Mariani has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+5' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Razvan Sava stops the ball from going inside right post.
90+4' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
90+2' The referee blows his whistle as Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) was too aggressive in his challenge.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:1.
85' Ederson (Atalanta) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
82' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to substitute Charles De Ketelaere and he is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Bravo (Udinese) will replace Alexis Sanchez.
79' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
77' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
74' A mistimed header from the middle of the box by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) goes well wide of the left post.
74' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atalanta.
73' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
71' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 2:13.
67' Here is a change. Martin Payero is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sandi Lovric trots off the pitch and is replaced by Arthur Atta (Udinese).
65' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
63' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) plays a through ball but overhits it.
62' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Ademola Lookman is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
62' A substitution has been made. Mario Pasalic goes off and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) comes on.
60' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Hassane Kamara (Udinese) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
58' Ederson (Atalanta) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
56' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Maurizio Mariani ignores the protests.
54' Total attempts – 10:1.
52' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
51' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is substituted due to injury. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Rui Modesto.
49' Looks like Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
48' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
47' Maurizio Mariani shows the yellow card to Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) for a heavy challenge.
46' Gian Piero Gasperini makes a switch. Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) is coming on in place of Giorgio Scalvini at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Isak Hien (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

45' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) jumps high inside the box to head the rebound down towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi pulls off an amazing reflex save to keep the ball out of the net. Nice goalkeeping skill!
45' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the crossbar!
45' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
40' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
39' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
36' Corner kicks – 5:0.
33' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
33' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
33' Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
32' A lofted cross from Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
31' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) quickly picks up the rebound and drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. The opponent's goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
29' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
27' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
26' Udinese have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' The resulting set piece from Udinese is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
24' It looks like Berat Djimsiti may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Gian Piero Gasperini replaces him with Isak Hien (Atalanta).
23' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' The game is interrupted now, Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

22' Nice move, nice attempt! Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
21' 1:0 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
20' Udinese can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
19' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
14' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) plays a through ball but overhits it.
10' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
8' Maurizio Mariani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and blew his whistle.
6' Martin Payero (Udinese) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
4' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Maurizio Mariani no option but to blow his whistle.
2' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The match has just started.
Udinese will kick the game off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Maurizio Mariani will officiate today.
